page.content:
Hooded, later chrome-masked, founder who leads Cobra.

How Cobra Commander connects

  • Faction: Cobra — Cobra Commander founded and leads Cobra.
  • Character: Serpentor — Serpentor's coup splits Cobra against Cobra Commander.
  • Character: Duke — Duke's field command is aimed at Cobra Commander.

What is Cobra Commander?

Cobra Commander is the high-voiced tyrant of Cobra, first a hood and then a silver faceplate, whose schemes Duke's team spends the file-card war trying to stop.

Key threads lead to Cobra, Serpentor and Duke.
